scope: Local source review and output/resource audit, not penetration testing
credential_patterns: No AWS access key, GitHub credential, private-key or long JWT match in authored website files
dom: No innerHTML, eval, dynamically injected URL, user input, cookies or tracking endpoint. JSON content is escaped at static generation.
network: Only same-origin static assets. External Instagram/GitHub links are ordinary user-initiated navigation.
rights: Original project art and geometry; existing font OFL files retained; no supplied reference-video assets republished.
local_resources: Eight HTML pages and their local links/assets checked; no broken local resource.
